security_alerts.conclusion: Alert inventory is incomplete; zero open issues is not proof of no security findings.

risks_and_follow_up.summary: Six broader regression failures reproduce on the prior commit; triage without weakening safety behavior.
Trustworthy Execution workflow triggers an older branch and is not an automatic main gate; main CI does not run the sampled failing suites.
The legacy remote approval handler checks a paired token and passes a task ID to approve; v2 separately verifies an action-hash-bound proof. Do not infer full legacy digest-binding assurance.
Current usage reservations are in-process; a durable multi-user quota ledger and provider threshold enforcement are future work.

Android and iPhone/iOS are in product scope; actual compatibility is not established. Android minSdk is 26, optional native llama.cpp targets arm64-v8a and API 28, and no iOS app was found under apps/. iOS implementation, supported versions and physical devices remain open.
No domain, VPS, hosting or gateway chosen; this does not block local development and synthetic tests.
Raw local logs were temporary and are not included; capture durable redacted evidence and full security, platform and acceptance results before an S0 exit or release decision.

evidence_retention: Local test logs were captured temporarily but are not included in the repository; commands and summarized results are recorded for reproduction.
